scope: Compare the current long R3 base target against predeclared ordinal H12-net targets, and test short ordinal thresholds plus training-only weights. Offline research only; no base, meta, policy, inference, or exchange artifact is promoted or modified.

invariants.population: Every arm scores the same target-free, decision-time executable candidate population. Label validity, policy path availability, and outcomes do not affect feature coverage, scoring population, or tail membership.
invariants.time: The train window is Jan-Mar 2024 with labels resolved before 2024-04-01. April-June 2024 is held OOS and is not used for feature selection, HPO, target promotion, ordinal bin-score mapping, or policy selection.
invariants.ordinal: Ordinal bins are H12 net <= lower, lower..0, 0..upper, and > upper. The ordinal score uses only training-bin robust net medians and never an OOS-derived mapping.
invariants.weights: Short boundary-certainty, square-root class, and hybrid weights apply only to training loss. They cannot become OOS/inference features, ranks, or policy inputs.
invariants.policy_diagnostic: The short exact-1m parent policy is side-correct, fixed before OOS scoring, costed once, and joined only after score-tail selection. It has no HPO or promotion authority. Missing exact paths remain unavailable labels rather than economic failures.

validation.not_run_reason: No full repository suite: this is a self-contained offline research runner with focused causal/weighting tests.
